summary: Alps Group Inc, a Cayman-incorporated, Malaysia-based Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on October 8, 2026 furnishing notice and proxy materials for an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) to be held October 21, 2026. The sole proposals are a five-for-one share consolidation (Ordinary and Preferred par value rising from US$0.0001 to US$0.0005) and a related share capital increase. This is a routine corporate-action/EGM notice, not a special situation. The board recommends approval; no advisor, price per share, premium, or strategic transaction is disclosed. Watch for shareholder approval and any subsequent reverse-split market effect, but no risk-arb angle applies.
